title.value: CoSP: Co-supervised pretraining of pocket and ligand
title.justification: The title is a concise summary of the paper's subject matter, focusing on the co-supervised pretraining framework the authors introduce for pockets and ligands.
title.quote: CoSP: Co-supervised pretraining of pocket and ligand

extractions.description: This paper introduces the CoSP framework for co-supervised pretraining of 3D pocket and ligand representations. The framework models both chemical features and geometric features of pockets and ligands using a gated geometric message passing layer. The authors propose a contrastive loss and chemical similarity-enhanced negative sampling strategy to improve the pretraining. Extensive experiments demonstrate competitive results in tasks such as pocket matching, molecule property predictions, and virtual screening, indicating the potential of CoSP for AI-driven drug discovery.
